Instantly vs. Instantaneously
So, my boyfriend uses the word "instantaneously" more often than I've heard the average person use.  I admit to not having the best grammar myself, but we always get into small disagreements.  For example, my bf just said if we bought frosties and had to leave them in a (hot) car, they would melt instantaneously.

Is this proper usuage ?
And what is the difference between the two?
